compile.nuance: 4 of 7 options map directly to current B3-2-03 'Rent Payment History' text (eff. 02/05/2025): O-FNM-55307 (rent-vs-VOA alignment), O-FNM-55101 (60-day large-deposit review, cross-ref B3-4.2-02), O-FNM-55100 (12-month asset verification report from an authorized DU validation service vendor), O-FNM-55098 (>=12 months renting, >=$300/month). Two options show apparent drift from a superseded Guide version: O-FNM-55097 (DVS-Rent Payment History First-Time Homebuyer) requires 'at least 1 borrower being a first-time homebuyer with a credit score', and O-FNM-55099 (DVS-Rent Payment History Occupancy) requires 'a purchase secured by a principal residence' -- neither condition appears in the current B3-2-03 eligibility list, which instead requires only (no mortgage on credit report) OR (limited credit history) OR (no credit score), with no purchase/occupancy/first-time-homebuyer restriction stated; B3-2-03's Announcement history (SEL-2019-06 through SEL-2025-01) shows repeated eligibility revisions to this feature, so these two exception codes likely predate a liberalization. One option, O-FNM-56237 (Positive Rent Data Previous Rent -- former-address data-entry mechanic for movers), has no corresponding text anywhere in the Selling Guide corpus (grepped 'former address' / 'previous rent' / 'rent payment change', zero hits) and is likely a DU UI/job-aid mechanic rather than Guide policy. Recommend Guide-currency re-verification of O-FNM-55097/O-FNM-55099 against current DU job aids before promoting to active.

notes: dominant_type threshold_eligibility is a clear plurality (3/7), though two of those three (55097, 55099) carry the citation_drift flag above -- see compile.nuance.
